summary: Round-seven evidence confirms lifecycle defects in external-ZooKeeper TLS inheritance and TLS option persistence after rotation. The gate is incomplete and this patch is not ready. No Solr source branch, PR description, or public comment was changed.

secure_example_bats.failure: Test 6 fails at test_secure_example.bats:252 on the first solr zk ls against the configured secure port: ZooKeeper reports 'the trustAnchors parameter must be non-empty'. The PKCS12 fixture is also used as its truststore but contains no trusted certificate entry. Password-file assertions earlier in test 6 pass; the test's later listener assertions are not reached.
behavior_observations: EOF on the existing-home prompt fails closed and preserves the marker (test 2).
The exact responses 'no', whitespace, and literal quoted-empty ("") are declined and preserve the marker on this head (test 3).
Enter confirms reset and removes the marker (test 4).
The --no-prompt two-node secure example starts successfully (test 1).

An unusable password-file path aborts before launch and is cleaned up; the touch interceptor under caller umask 022 observes both password files at mode 0600 at creation, and post-creation mode checks pass before test 6's trust-anchor failure.

automatic_embedded_tls.tls_listener: Connected on secureClientPort 33000; configured plaintext clientPort 33001 refused connections.

external_plaintext_zookeeper_with_shared.result: The same plaintext ensemble on port 34000 is reachable without the embedded-TLS include; with that include, the client attempts TLS and times out.

tls_rotation.initial: Solr 32111 starts; secure ZooKeeper 33111 and CLI connect; TLS handshake presents CN=localhost-one.
tls_rotation.after_restart_with_new_solr_port_and_sto: Solr 32113 start returns 0; old secure port 33111 remains open, expected new port 33113 is closed; zoo.cfg and shared include remain byte-for-byte unchanged with old port, keystore/truststore paths, and old truststore option.
tls_rotation.clients: Stale-option CLI still connects (exit 0); a client using the new truststore fails (exit 1), and the listener still presents the old self-signed certificate.

user_managed_secure_client_port_and_zoo_.zoo_cfg: Byte-identical before and after start; operator-managed file was not rewritten.

non_writable_include.result: Launcher emits a permission-denied write error but still reports that TLS options were added; the include remains unchanged with no TLS options, and the subsequent CLI fails with a timeout (exit 1).

lifecycle_probes.password_creation: Current-head BATS verifies invalid destination failure before launch and 0600 creation under umask 022; the isolated 077-to-022 mutation makes the touch interceptor fail as required.

recommended_smallest_safe_boundary: Keep the repair within the automatic embedded-ZooKeeper TLS lifecycle in solr/bin/solr and the SolrZkServer configuration boundary: derive client options for the selected ZooKeeper target instead of persisting embedded TLS options globally in a shared include; refresh only explicitly auto-managed zoo.cfg/include TLS fields atomically on restart while preserving user-owned files; and fail clearly rather than claiming success when a required write is denied. Add regression coverage for external plaintext ZK, repeated start/rotation, and user-managed secureClientPort/zoo.cfg.
